name: Arduino Uno
description: The Arduino Uno is one of the most popular microcontroller boards for beginners and professionals alike. Built around the ATmega328P, it is perfect for learning electronics, prototyping IoT projects, and building automation systems.

name: Arduino Nano
description: The Arduino Nano packs the power of a traditional Arduino into a compact breadboard-friendly form factor. Ideal for space-constrained projects, robotics, wearable devices, and embedded systems development.

name: Arduino Mega256
description: The Arduino Mega 2560 offers a large number of digital and analog I/O pins, making it perfect for complex projects that require multiple sensors, displays, motors, and communication modules.

name: ESP32 Devkit V1
description: The ESP32 Devkit V1 features built-in Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity, making it an excellent choice for IoT applications, smart home devices, wireless monitoring systems, and connected products.

name: Raspberry Pi 5
description: The Raspberry Pi 5 is a powerful single-board computer capable of running desktop operating systems, media centers, servers, AI projects, and advanced embedded applications with impressive performance.
